d:
‘New Dawn’, the closing track of the Grammy-nominated album “Chapter II: How Dark it is Before Dawn”, recorded in a single take at De Singel Arts Centre in Antwerp, looped free of a click track.
Directed by Ali Clifton
Music composed and arranged by Anoushka Shankar and Peter Raeburn
Arranged for live performance by Danny Keane
Band:
Arun Ghosh: Clarinet
Pirashanna Thevarajah: Percussion
Sarathy Korwar: Drums
